description: Matrix calculator — Exact linear algebra offline: a= matrix with rows separated by ; and values by , (up to 25x25). Default summary: rank, determinant, trace, inverse, 1-norm condition number + conditioning label, transpose, eigenvalues (symmetric: Jacobi with eigenvectors and definiteness; general: Hessenberg + shifted QR incl. complex pairs). op=det|inverse|solve|rank|eigen|transpose|multiply|lu|power; b= vector or matrix for solve (exact, or least squares when non-square/singular, with residual) and multiply; k= exponent for power (negative uses the inverse). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_matrix
